text: Crane starts successfully with the target smaller supported Gemma4 model and reaches healthy state.
Unsupported Gemma4 structure fails before serving traffic with a diagnostic compatibility error.
Existing supported Gemma4 startup behavior remains intact for previously working variants.
A CUDA Docker image containing the Gemma4 loader fix is built and published from my69.
Cluster deployment is updated to the new image and verified with health checks.
